status: parameters preserved from the source project fit; NOT re-implemented or re-validated in this repository
form: out = (1-b)*dry + b*H2(f(H1(x))); f(u) = G*u/(1+|G*u/L|^p)^(1/p) + m*u with L = Lp for u>=0 and Ln for u<0; H1 = first-order highpass fh_hz x first-order lowpass fl_hz (magnitude); H2 = quiet-rung response of MYTH15 over MYTH13 (Blend max over Blend min), relative to its value at 110Hz
input_scale: linear amplitude at the capture of the dry path (the Blend-min / MYTH13 return), where a -23dBFS-peak probe returns at about -14dBFS
fitted: 2026-09-20, source project monomyth_model.py: 110Hz level-steps harmonics (noise-gated below -60dB) plus the ess_ladder level dependence of MYTH15 vs MYTH13; settled Drive 12:00, Voice 12:00

source_validation.music_metric: RMS over six spectral band levels plus a per-note THD ratio, played-performance re-amp, model vs capture
